document.abstract: Representative prescriptions, together with performance evaluations, are given for six designs in a sequence developed to improve performance of an eight-element ballistic camera lens. The lens was redesigned with the LASL program, which analyzes lens performance statistically by multiple ray tracing and minimizes image defects by the least-squares method. The design giving best performance uses ordinary low-index glasses.
